title: MongoDB Enterprise Advanced VM Instance Parameters
description: Parameters for provisioning a MongoDB Enterprise Advanced 8.3.17 VM instance on IBM Z (s390x)

source_container_disk.description: Full MongoDB EA s390x VM container disk image reference (registry/repo:tag). Required.

database_name.description: Name of the application database to create

ha_enabled.description: Enable High Availability replica set deployment (3-member RS)

ha_replica_count.description: Number of replica set members (must be odd: 3, 5, or 7)

vm_cpu_cores.description: Number of vCPU cores per VM

disk_size_gi.description: Boot disk size per VM in GiB

storage_class_name.description: Storage class for the VM boot PVC (must support RWO block on s390x)

vip_enabled.description: Enable VIP LoadBalancer service for primary-only HA access

vip_lb_type.description: VIP service type: local (NodePort) or external (MetalLB LoadBalancer)

compliance_enable_encryption.description: Enable WiredTiger encryption-at-rest (requires MongoDB EA licence)
